# The package a grpc: import writes, run against the gRPC server the script
# harness runs at 127.0.0.1:47820 (internal/testgrpc), which reads and writes
# with protobuf's own runtime.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'
! stderr .

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '10 tests, 0 failures'


-- app.sngl --
// Every kind of field read back from the server, every kind sent and echoed,
// a status classified, each kind of stream, and the component over a
// read-only method.

import async "sngl:async"
import library "grpc:./library.proto"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const local = "127.0.0.1:47820"

func testGet(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=7}) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.id == 7)
            t.assert(b.title == "Book 7")
            t.assert(b.tags == ["old", "rare"])
            t.assert(b.kind == library.BookKind.paperback)
            t.assert(b.pages == 320)
            t.assert(b.added != null && b.added.seconds == 1700000000 && b.added.nanos == 5)
            t.assert(b.scores.length() == 1 && b.scores["plot"] == 4.5)
            t.assert(b.cover == "aGk=")
            t.assert(b.ranks == [-1, 2])
            t.assert(b.rating == 0.5)
            t.assert(b.isbn == 978)
            t.assert(b.lent)
            t.assert(b.place == library.BookPlace{loan=library.Loan{to="Ada", due=5}})
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
    // A oneof set to a member holding its zero is still that member.
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=2}) {
        ok { t.assert(b.place.shelf == "") }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

// A 64-bit field is an int64, which every target holds whole: Kotlin's int
// is 32 bits.
func testWide(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=64}) {
        ok { t.assert(b.isbn == 9780000000002) }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testAdd(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    var sent = library.Book{
        id=1,
        title="Dune",
        tags=["sf"],
        kind=library.BookKind.hardCover,
        pages=412,
        added=library.Timestamp{seconds=-5, nanos=1},
        scores={"plot"=5.0, "pace"=-1.25},
        cover="aGk=",
        ranks=[-3, 0, 70000],
        rating=-2.5,
        isbn=42,
        lent=true,
        place={bin=0},
    }
    match var b = library.addBookCall({book=sent}) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.id == 99)
            t.assert(b.title == "added: Dune")
            t.assert(b.tags == sent.tags)
            t.assert(b.kind == sent.kind)
            t.assert(b.pages == 412)
            t.assert(b.added != null && b.added.seconds == -5 && b.added.nanos == 1)
            t.assert(b.scores.length() == 2 && b.scores["plot"] == 5.0 && b.scores["pace"] == -1.25)
            t.assert(b.cover == sent.cover)
            t.assert(b.ranks == sent.ranks)
            t.assert(b.rating == sent.rating)
            t.assert(b.isbn == 42)
            t.assert(b.lent)
            t.assert(b.place == sent.place)
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testZeros(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    match var b = library.addBookCall({book=library.Book{}}) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.title == "added: ")
            t.assert(b.pages == null)
            t.assert(b.added == null)
            t.assert(b.kind == library.BookKind.unspecified)
            t.assert(b.tags.length() == 0)
            t.assert(b.place == library.BookPlace.none)
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testStatus(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=404}) {
        ok { t.assert(b.title == "") }
        failed {
            t.assert(b.kind == async.FailureKind.request)
            t.assert(b.code == "NOT_FOUND")
            t.assert(b.message == "no book 404")
        }
    }
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=16}) {
        ok { t.assert(b.title == "") }
        failed { t.assert(b.kind == async.FailureKind.auth) }
    }
    t.setContext(library.server, "")
    match var b = library.getBookCall({id=1}) {
        ok { t.assert(b.title == "") }
        failed { t.assert(b.code == "UNAVAILABLE") }
    }
}

func testWatch(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    var titles list[string] = []
    match var r = library.watchCall({id=3}, func(b library.Book) { titles.push(b.title) }) {
        ok { t.assert(r == 3) }
        failed { t.assert(r.message == "") }
    }
    t.assert(titles == ["Book 1", "Book 2", "Book 3"])
    // The messages before a failure are handed on, then the failure answered.
    var seen = 0
    match var r = library.watchCall({id=404}, func(b library.Book) { seen += 1 }) {
        ok { t.assert(r < 0) }
        failed {
            t.assert(r.code == "NOT_FOUND")
            t.assert(r.message == "the shelf is gone")
        }
    }
    t.assert(seen == 1)
}

// A stream that never ends is ended by its lifetime, here from the function
// handed each message.
func testWatchEnded(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    var life = async.begin()
    var seen = 0
    var each = func(b library.Book) {
        seen += 1
        if seen == 3 {
            life.end()
        }
    }
    match var r = library.watchCall({id=0}, each, life=life) {
        ok { t.assert(r < 0) }
        failed { t.assert(r.kind == async.FailureKind.cancelled) }
    }
    t.assert(seen == 3)
}

func testCollect(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    match var b = library.collectCall([{id=1}, {id=2}, {id=4}]) {
        ok {
            t.assert(b.id == 7)
            t.assert(b.title == "3 books")
        }
        failed { t.assert(b.message == "") }
    }
}

func testEcho(t test.Test) {
    t.setContext(library.server, local)
    var titles list[string] = []
    match var r = library.echoCall([{id=5}, {id=6}], func(b library.Book) { titles.push(b.title) }) {
        ok { t.assert(r == 2) }
        failed { t.assert(r.message == "") }
    }
    t.assert(titles == ["echo 5", "echo 6"])
}

component shelf ui.node {
    var id int64 = 3
    var found option[library.Book] = null
    library.server(local) {
        library.getBook(request={id=id}, :value=found)
    }
    ui.text #title(value=found != null ? found.title : "-")
    ui.button #next(text="Next", @click { id += 1 })
    var latest = "-"
    var count = 0
    ui.text #streamed(value="{latest} of {count}")
    ui.button #watch(text="Watch", @click {
        library.server(local) {
            match var r = library.watchCall({id=4}, func(b library.Book) { latest = b.title }) {
                ok { count = r }
                failed { latest = r.message }
            }
        }
    })
}

func testComponent(t test.Test, c shelf) {
    t.wait(func() => c.title.value == "Book 3", 5000)
    c.next.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.title.value == "Book 4", 5000)
    t.assert(c.title.value == "Book 4")
    // A message streamed into state shows as it comes.
    c.watch.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.streamed.value == "Book 4 of 4", 5000)
}

ui.window {
    shelf
}
-- library.proto --
syntax = "proto3";

package library.v1;

import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";

// A book on a shelf.
message Book {
  // The book's id.
  int64 id = 1;
  string title = 2;
  repeated string tags = 3;
  BookKind kind = 4;
  optional int32 pages = 5;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp added = 6;
  map<string, double> scores = 7;
  bytes cover = 8;
  repeated sint32 ranks = 9;
  float rating = 10;
  fixed64 isbn = 11;
  bool lent = 12;
  // Where the book is.
  oneof place {
    string shelf = 13;
    Loan loan = 14;
    int32 bin = 15;
  }
}

message Loan {
  string to = 1;
  int64 due = 2;
}

enum BookKind {
  BOOK_KIND_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  BOOK_KIND_HARD_COVER = 1;
  BOOK_KIND_PAPERBACK = 2;
}

message GetBookRequest {
  int64 id = 1;
}

message AddBookRequest {
  Book book = 1;
}

service Library {
  // Answers one book.
  rpc GetBook(GetBookRequest) returns (Book) {
    option idempotency_level = NO_SIDE_EFFECTS;
  }
  // Answers the book it was handed, its id 99 and its title marked added.
  rpc AddBook(AddBookRequest) returns (Book);
  // Answers books 1 to id, one at a time.
  rpc Watch(GetBookRequest) returns (stream Book);
  // Answers one book: its id the sum of the ids sent, its title how many.
  rpc Collect(stream GetBookRequest) returns (Book);
  // Answers a book per request, of its id.
  rpc Echo(stream GetBookRequest) returns (stream Book);
}
